title: Filtered continuity of derived abelian evaluation at an affine pro-etale object
statement: For a scheme X and an affine object W of its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let E_W be evaluation of abelian sheaves at W. For every small filtered category I in the coefficient universe and every q≥0, the functor F↦H^q(RE_W(F[0])) preserves colimits of shape I. Derived functors and homology use [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tag 09A3; source implementation WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/ProEtale/CohomologyFilteredColimit.lean, with Stacks Tags 03Q6 and 03F3 for cohomology and localization

proof.text: Apply the existing source-library Sheaf.H_map_isColimit_of_isFiltered_small to the terminal object of the pro-etale site of W.left. The qcqs class satisfies its finite Cech-cover condition by Scheme.ProEt.exists_finite_cechNerve_of_mem_topology. The elementwise surjectivity and eventual-zero criteria imply that the cohomology functor preserves filtered colimits, using the forgetful functor to types to reflect the colimit.

The source-library nonempty_rightDerived_sections_iso_functorH naturally identifies this cohomology with classical right-derived global sections. Localization along W→X is exact and preserves colimits and injectives. Evaluation is localization followed by global sections, so rightDerivedCompIsoOfExact identifies its classical derived functors with this colimit-preserving composite.

Use the source-library singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso to identify the classical derived functor with homology of total derived evaluation on degree-zero sheaves. Transport colimit preservation along this natural isomorphism and the functor associator.

theorem derivedEvaluation_preservesFiltered
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W : X.ProEt) [IsAffine W.left]
    (I : Type (u + 1)) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (q : ℕ) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape I
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0 ⋙
        (sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
          (evaluation X.ProEtᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op W)).rightDerivedFunctor) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (q : ℤ))
